title: A leftover test message from MettleUp sits in every gym's notification bell
what: The live list of messages from MettleUp HQ holds one message, sent on 31 Oct: 'Test HQ to Admin Message. How are you'. The same list goes to every gym, so every gym owner, a new paying gym too, sees this test in the bell. Messages stay for 120 days, so it shows until late February unless someone removes it.
expected: Only real messages meant for gym owners reach the bell; tests are removed or never sent to every gym.
evidence: url:https://app.mettleup.fit/api/hq-news answered 200 with message id 2 'Test HQ to Admin Message' on 2026-11-26
how_often: every time the bell opens until it is removed
fix_line: Remove the test message on the HQ Messages page

evidence: url:https://app.mettleup.fit/ served index--GfMsOId.js on 2026-11-26; the area's long on-screen sentences are in it except the plan-ended banner (switch off)
url:https://app.mettleup.fit/api/ai/match-columns answered 401 Sign in first on 2026-11-26 (key and link set)
url:https://app.mettleup.fit/api/switches answered joinPay true aiCharge true on 2026-11-26
